title: Relative denominators and effective systems for log Calabi-Yau fibrations
main_claim: For projective lc pairs (X,B) of dim d<=4 with coefficients in a fixed finite set Phi and K_X+B ~_Q f^*D over a contraction f:X->Z, there are uniform p0|p and a DCC set B such that, after an exact presentation K_X+B+(1/p0)Div(psi)=f^*(K_Z+B_Z+M_Z), B_Z has coefficients in B, (Z,B_Z+M_Z) is generalized lc (klt if (X,B) is klt), and pM is b-Cartier (b-nef). Corollaries: an effective Iitaka-type system |floor(l(K_X+B))| when D is big, and an rc-torsion result.

issues.location: sec:residue, uniform degree p (Jiang-Liu Cor 1.6); sec:curve MMP (Chen-Tsakanikas Thm 1.1); depth theorem (Kollar Families 11.18)
issues.description: The uniform degree rests on cited external theorems: the bounded index for projective slc log CY pairs of dim <=3 with finite coefficients, termination of flips for pseudo-effective NQC lc 4-folds over a curve, and the depth theorem used to get S2/demi-normality of the reduced fibre. Their hypotheses seem to be met as used, but I could not check the exact statements offline.
issues.evidence: The lemma's p is chosen from HMX global ACC plus JiangLiu21 Cor 1.6. The MMP endpoint relies on ChenTsakanikas23 Thm 1.1/1.2. Demi-normality of T relies on Kollar Families Thm 11.18 applied with D=T, L=0.

coverage:
Main theorem (Thm 1.1) checked step by step:
- Generic fibre: lc, Hilbert-90 descent of the principalizing function in degree p0, and the exact presentation via h in K^*.
- Fujino-Gongyo rank-one condition, ACC thresholds (HMX) giving a DCC B_Z, and the coefficient formula coeff M_W = alpha+t-1-coeff K_W.
- Curve slice: canonical divisor defined via residues of theta_V*prod chi_j, which keeps coeff alpha at c.
- E = Gamma-B^c-tF is effective near c and zero on one fibre component; horizontal part is exceptional.
- MMP over C: no fibre-type step; q-negativity kills the horizontal part of E_N; Delta = lambda F_N - E_N is anti-nef, so E_N = lambda F_N; lambda = 0 via KM 3.38 monotonicity.
- Residue lemma:
  - m | e_i from integrality.
  - The root cover is quasi-etale and crepant; dlt upstairs via purity; Div s = -p0(T_Y+H_Y); character zeta^{-a}.
  - The ratios r_j are constant because b-th powers of both forms generate the adjunction sheaf on the normal projective T_{Y,j}.
  - H is absent at codim-2 crossings; even-p next residues glue the scalars over the connected T_Y.
  - mu_m-invariance of pi^*u forces m | p/p0.
- Prop effective-base: section-space identity and Birkar-Zhang Thm 1.3 pushforward checked.
- rc-torsion Prop only skimmed.
